people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Write these words; for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”
translations.bsb: The LORD also said to Moses, “Write down these words, for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.
